in_marathi.name: Ravikant
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे sun, divine, powerful
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ravikant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Ravikant is derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Ravi' which means 'Sun' and 'Kant' which means 'Divine' or 'Powerful'. This name is evocative of the power and radiance of the sun, and the divine wisdom it represents. It is a name that inspires strength, courage, and a deep connection to the divine.
